text: I'm a childminder and I've got a little girl of 3 with me overnight while her parents are stuck abroad. She's got chickenpox, very itchy spots, and now her temperature is 38.5 and I'm worried I've missed something. She says her throat hurts as well but she's drinking her juice and water okay. Otherwise she's actually her usual self, chatting away and playing with her doll. I've never had one this hot in my care before so I'm a bit shaken. Is that normal with chickenpox?
